page.layout: Running head at top centre-left: "LIBER QVINTVS." with page number "139" at top right. Below it, two parallel columns: Greek on the left, its Latin translation on the right. Below the columns, one full-width Latin paragraph, with a marginal note in the right margin ("Duplex agmen."). A gathering signature "Ss 2" sits at the foot, with the hyphenated line "socio-" just above it. The left margin holds fragments of the neighbouring page's text, which are not transcribed.

main_text.p: τῖς ἕλλησι χϱ̃ ἔϱ τὸ μέρος. οἱ μὲν ἕλληνες ἐν τῷ στρατοπεδεύειν ἡ- συχῶς κυριώτατον τὸ κατακολουθεῖν ταῖς ἐξ αὐτῶν τῶν τόπων ὀχυρώσεσιν, ἅμα μὲν ἐγκλίνοντες τὴν πρὸς τὰς ἀσφαλείας παλαιπωρίαν, ἅμα ὃ νομίζοντες ἀχ ὁμοίας εἶναι τὰς χαρακοποιίας ἀσφαλείας, ταῖς ἐξ αὐτῶν τὸ φύσεως ἀπὸ τῶν τόπων ὑπαρχόδαις ὀχυρώσεις. διὸ ἔ. κατά τε τὸ τὸ ὅλης παρεμβολῆς θέσιν, πᾶν ἀναλογίζον) ἀ̃ημα μηλαμβάνουσιν ἐπόμενοι τῆς τόποις, ἴατε μέρη μεταλλάττειν ἄλλο τε πρὸς ἀλλήλας ἐκ καταλλήλως τόπας. ἐξ ὧν ἀνάγκην ὑπάρχειν συμβαίνει καὶ τὴν καθ' ἰδίαν, ἐκ τὴν τῇ μέρος ἑκάσῳ τ- πον τῆς στρατοπεδείας. Ῥωμαῖοι δὲ τὴν πρὸς τὰς ἰάφρας ταλαιπωρίαν, ἐκ τὰ ἄλλα τὰ παρεπόμενα τοῖς ὑπομένειν αἰρῦν) χάριν τὸ δύχε- ρείας, ἐκ ἐγνώκμον ἐκ μίαν ἔχειν ἐκ τῷ αὐτῷ αἰεὶ παρεμβολῷ.

Græcis hac in parte viam instituisse. Græci enim in metatione præcipuum censent, sequi & captare ex ipsis locis firmitatem: ideoque & in universa castrorum positura, quamlibet formam assumunt necessario, locis obsequentes, & partes ipsas commutare aliter atque aliter pro situ. E quibus incertum accidit locum esse & priuatim cuique & in partibus assignandum. Romani vero illam quæ circa fossas est ærumnam & laborem, quæque alia adhærent, subire eligunt, causa facilitatis & aptitudinis, & vt notam atque unicam camdemque semper habeant metationem.

Pluscula hæc verba sunt, & ideò in plerisque clara. Summa eorum est (utiliter enim contraham:) duplex genusDuplex agmen. Agminis esse. Prius commune, & cùm sine motu incedunt: quod est tale. Præeunt & exeunt Extraordinarij, & agmen ducunt. Cur illi? quia portæ Prætoriæ vicini, per quam ferè egressus: atque etiam quia ordine pænè illo exeant, quo metati. Secundi, cornu Dextrum socio-

page.notes: The Greek column is badly worn and is the least reliable part of this transcription. Words marked by the reader as doubtful should be checked against the scan. Several Greek words were not read with certainty and may contain errors in accents, breathings and letters. The Latin column and the full-width paragraph are clear. The marginal note "Duplex agmen." is placed beside the line "genus Agminis esse". The fragments in the left margin belong to the neighbouring page and were omitted.
